title: Task or recharge scheme
summary: A task platform promises earnings but asks for deposits or repeated recharges.
scenario: The balance appears to grow while withdrawals require more money or referrals.
warning_signs: Pressure to recruit or deposit again
safe_actions: Do not add funds to unlock a withdrawal
Stop contact and verify the organization independently
recovery_guidance: Preserve balances, receipts, and chat history
reporting_guidance: Record account identifiers and transaction references
Use only independently checked reporting routes
prevention_tips: Earnings should not require escalating deposits
Do not treat an in-app balance as proof of withdrawable money
false_positive_notes: Some platforms use paid services, but a guaranteed return and forced recharge deserve careful verification.
